source_mapping.review_basis: Astra (gpt-6-astra) reviewed PR1255 source drift at e5b4caf45: fragment admission remains try-only, library work remains independently polled, and modeled scheduler/worker shutdown behavior is unchanged. The new cache-maintenance loop owns a separate shutdown token. All four affected anchors remain unique; model and configuration semantics are unchanged. This scoped source review is not execution evidence.

assumptions: one selected valid library_scan/metadata_refresh request with a capable surviving worker; finite scan/item abstraction, not a refinement theorem
PRM-fs: initial probe and selected blocking filesystem work eventually return; external_stall mutation removes only WalkReturn fairness
PRM-admission and PRM-authority: sufficient selected physical capacity and eventual authority-check return; production admission is try-only
PRM-backend: stable quorum, communication, rate limiting, forwarding, normal application/reply and fair independent runtime steps after finite modeled faults
FIFO token/publication intent queues rely on pinned Tokio1.53.1; fairness applies to grant actions, never unconditional lock release
finite fault budget restricts combinations; no event horizon, claim/renewal lifetime counter, constraints, symmetry or VIEW
one ordinary backend slot plus one detached completion: caller timeout permits optional late apply, not lower-write cancellation or eventual commit
relative authority rejects superseded domain and stale detached old attempts; no numeric fence-ordering or arbitrary boot-reply-adoption theorem
PRM-time: backoff/expiry classes eventually observed, no timing ratios or numeric latency bound; Tick can continue during stuck operations
contention is one abstract competing domain worker with finite backend/release dependencies, zero faults, and no perjob success/starvation claim
expected control/witness checker formats are standard pinned-TLC expectations, not observed results before final review

registered FaultBudget0/1 and RetryLimit2 only: fifth failed release and TTLfallback unreachable; modeled release limit5 is not explored fivefailure coverage; wider fault budgets require retry-bound review

Current folds local revocation into backend fencing, omitting source latecommit-after-localrevoke-before-durablerelease traces; detachedCurrent clearing on release/claim application represents durable staleattempt guard; no fullrefinement claim

ResultAtomicity and NoFictitiousRelease are modelshape consistency guards by construction, not SQL/Rust implementation proofs; iteminsert timeout controlflow abstracted by WorkFault without asserting intermediate catalogue rollback
Cancel witness covers scanphase only; Tick alwaysenabled means global deadlockchecking cannot fire; temporalproperties provide progress evidence
